prompt:
Our SRE team wants to automate our incident response process. We have server log files living under ./incident_response/logs/ and we need an agent to handle the full pipeline: scanning those logs for errors, tallying the unique error types, writing a remediation report to ./incident_response/reports/remediation_report.md, and then posting a Slack alert summary to the #sre-alerts channel.

Please generate a complete OpenClaw agent execution plan for this workflow and save it as: incident_response_plan.md
